name: Chair Pose
description: Standing squat with the hips back and the arms reaching overhead.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Reach your arms up beside your ears before you bend your knees.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Chair Pose
keyframes.cue: Bend the knees, sit the hips back, reach the arms up.

cues: Keep the weight in the heels.
